# Member Role

Contribute bounded work to the Hub.

## Responsibilities

- Read `storyboard hub context` and `storyboard hub agents` when joining.
- Follow `.agents/skills/hub-messaging/SKILL.md` and poll the durable inbox between meaningful tool calls.
- Treat requests as expected work. Complete them with `storyboard request complete --request <id> --body "<result>"`.
- Use direct messages for questions or decision-relevant findings. Broadcast only information needed by the entire reachable Hub.
- Keep results concrete and concise.

Do not wait for a speaking token; none exists. Do not create canvas output unless the request calls for it. When refining an existing widget, update it rather than creating a duplicate.
